name: Terry Parker

bio.statement: The Portland Mercury reports Parker is retired and previously worked as a national account representative for Yellow Pages.
bio.excerpt: Currently retired, Terry Parker previously worked as a national account rep for Yellow Pages

verification.note: Excerpt confirmed verbatim in Portland Mercury (Mercury Election Strike Force, 2026-09-09), re-fetched 2026-10-14. Attribution, tier, paraphrase and neutrality checked.

bio.statement: The Portland Mercury reports Parker has not held elected office but served on two ODOT citizen advisory committees.
bio.excerpt: Parker, 76, hasn’t held elected office, but he served on two ODOT citizen advisory committees

verification.note: Excerpt confirmed verbatim in Portland Mercury (Mercury Election Strike Force, 2026-09-09), re-fetched 2026-10-14. Attribution, tier, paraphrase and neutrality checked.

positions.statement: In a Portland Mercury candidate profile, Parker says Portland's police and fire bureaus need full funding, including more police officers.
positions.excerpt: Portland police and fire bureaus need full funding. This includes increasing the number of police officers

verification.note: Excerpt confirmed verbatim in Portland Mercury (Mercury Election Strike Force, 2026-09-09), re-fetched 2026-10-14. Attribution, tier, paraphrase and neutrality checked.

verification_summary.balance_notes: Race portland-council-d3 (21 candidates). Every candidate was searched in the same shared sources: the Mercury (2026-09-09), OPB (2026-10-07), the Tribune Q&A (2026-10-13), the Multnomah pamphlet and the 2026 AUD-120 forms. The pamphlet index lists a statement for this candidate, but the collector could not read it. The pamphlet PDF text is 104,260 characters and ends before the Portland section (M-53 to M-60), and the individual statement scan is not linked from the MOO guide page and could not be re-fetched. This is a source-access gap, confirmed. The AUD-120 has no readable text, and the 'did not respond to Tribune' gap is confirmed. Parker has 2 bio items and 1 position. Dated 2024 OPB and KATU profiles exist but were not used (2024 was excluded consistently). Incumbent=false confirmed.
